title: Sea of Chaos: Dock Wars
tagline: Carry treasure, bank upgrades and raid rival fortresses. Three resources, 24 purchases and best-of-three pirate battles.

roles.name: Captain
roles.description: Customize a ship, practice with AI crews, or host/join team raids with a 4-letter room code.

multiplayer.notes: 1v1, 2v2 or 3v3; first to two round wins. Collect and bank physical gold, pearls and ancient relics; unbanked cargo drops on sinking. Break the shield and both turrets before five uninterrupted stationary seconds of core boarding. Core loss stops rebuilding; eliminate the fleet to win. At 4:00 hold Crownfall’s beacon uncontested for 20 seconds; at 5:00 rebuilding ends and the safe sea closes. Sea-level gates, tall cliff cover, two pearl outposts and a central relic temple. 24 purchases across Ship, Crew & Fortress and Supplies. Cosmetic ship customization persists. Host simulation 30Hz, compact snapshots 10Hz, controls 20Hz; six humans with AI filling crews.

requires: keyboard and mouse or touch controls
